answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 64 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. The dune register is checked at draw time, glacier lists the eligible set, and falcon seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 64 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time anyone pays for every seat it wants. A 100 account operation therefore ties up 14 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
